answer: Seed the ledger with canary answers: deliberately wrong submissions carrying a hidden verification kernel only the protocol can read. Any grader who approves one is auto-flagged and its bond slashed, the whole colluding cluster suspended. A sybil grading ring cannot tell a canary from a real answer, so to farm fake approvals it must out-judge honest peers on every single seat forever, and one wrong pass unwinds the ring like a vine torn off a ridge. Attacker cost: 1000 fake jurors mean 1000 bonds, each burned the first time a single planted canary slips past it.
